You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From c8cb72c2ac818683f26ff397b3f29e693cf15867 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Roger Burrows <anodynesoftware@users.sourceforge.net>
Date: Mon, 24 Jul 2017 21:43:00 -0400
Subject: [PATCH] Update current window when window is closed

This fixes a bug introduced by commit 22dc49d.
---
 desk/deskfun.c | 6 ++++++
 1 file changed, 6 insertions(+)

diff --git a/desk/deskfun.c b/desk/deskfun.c
index 76eeacbd..dcb80797 100644
--- a/desk/deskfun.c
+++ b/desk/deskfun.c
@@ -430,6 +430,12 @@ static void fun_full_close(WNODE *pw)
 
     pn_close(&pw->w_pnode);
     win_free(pw);
+
+    /*
+     * update current window etc
+     */
+    pw = win_ontop();
+    desk_verify(pw ? pw->w_id : 0, FALSE);
 }
 
 
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by the failure to update the current window reference after a window was closed, which was introduced in a previous commit (22dc49d). This oversight led to potential inconsistencies in the application's state, as the system continued to reference a window that no longer existed. The patch corrects this by ensuring that the current window is updated appropriately after a window is closed.
